browser.title: French empty state, examples prepare without sending, keyboard focus and no overflow
chat, explicit presentation, two packages and refresh restoration without inference
typed chat and selections work without the HTTPS-only randomUUID API
busy requests block duplicate submissions and historical choices stay inactive
cooldowns preserve failed text and allow inference-free choices, never automatic retry
lost successful response is recovered by GET without repeating the POST
uncertain pending request survives refresh and requires explicit status verification
manual retry uses a fresh request id and preserves the original failed message
new conversation waits for server invalidation; failed reset preserves messages
server expiry clears the temporary transcript and does not resend the question
elapsed local expiry clears messages and browser token
pharmacy cards expose readable provenance and safe contact links without stock claims
missing recorded price is explicit and never displayed as zero
invalid extraction response never renders an unvalidated factual answer
browser storage failure stays usable and explains refresh limitation
input limits, whitespace and IME composition never issue unintended requests
mobile layout and accessible empty/chat/reset states
multiple medication cards use server line totals and hide an incomplete order total
offered facet, pagination and reference actions send exact API values without text
user markup is text and unsafe source URLs never become links
real web/core/PostgreSQL: restore, quota error, inference-free choice, refresh, and reset

required_additions.scenario: Each service installs/imports from only its declared runtime dependencies; no cross-service implementation imports or provider SDK in core.
Both service startups reject missing/invalid/unavailable PostgreSQL configuration without a file or SQLite runtime fallback.
Offline tests inject explicit fixture repositories, interpreters and quota stores rather than selecting a production memory/files mode.
Service settings require only their own URL and never receive the other service's secret.
Legacy quota import reads but never rewrites the original ledger; PostgreSQL cooldowns/accounting survive.
React has timeout/connection and expired-choice coverage without automatic POST replay; retries use a new request ID.
Every archived file matches its recorded hash after line-ending policy is accounted for; current code never imports archived/retired modules.
Fresh and existing-revision PostgreSQL setup, complete factual round-trip, repeated import, backup/restore, outages and transcript/quota persistence pass in an isolated stack.
